description: A postural and mobility movement activating the upper back and lower traps against a flat wall.
setup: Stand with back, head, and buttocks flat against a smooth wall, heels a few inches out, with arms forming a goalpost W shape against the wall.
steps: Press wrists, elbows, and lower back gently into the wall surface.
Slide your arms upward along the wall into a high Y shape.
Reach overhead as high as you can while maintaining wall contact with elbows and hands.
Slide your arms back down slowly to the starting W position.
cues: Keep your lower back flat against the wall without arching your spine
Maintain contact with the wall through your elbows and wrists

mistakes.mistake: Arching the lower back to force arms onto the wall
mistakes.fix: Brace abs and keep tailbone and lower back glued against the wall

mistakes.mistake: Elbows or wrists peeling forward away from the wall
mistakes.fix: Only reach as high as you can while maintaining complete wall contact

rep_standard: Begins in 90-degree W goalpost position against wall, slides smoothly overhead to full extension while maintaining contact, and returns.
